test_tensor_follows_mask_structure: test the tensor_follows_mask_structure function to verify if a tensor follows a 2:4 sparsity mask pattern
infer_sparsity_structure_from_modifiers: infer the sparsity structure string from a list of compression modifier instances
infer_sparsity_structure_from_model: infer the sparsity structure of a PyTorch model by checking its linear layers for 2:4 sparsity patterns
infer_sparse_targets_and_ignores: infer sparse compression target and ignore layer lists from a model given a sparsity structure and threshold
test_is_sparse_compression_target: test the is_sparse_compression_target function to check if a module qualifies for sparse compression
